description: Event arguments raised when a TmTreeView node is dragged onto another node or the root drop zone. Passed to OnNodeMove. NewParent is null when the node should become a root node.

typeParameters.name: TKey
typeParameters.description: The type of the tree node identifier.

properties.name: NewParent
properties.description: The node onto which MovedNode was dropped, becoming its new parent. Null when the node was dropped on the root drop zone and should become a root-level node.

examples.title: Reparenting a node in response to OnNodeMove
